what: A shape button on a horizontal dotted path follows the mouse’s horizontal position in .1s (stopping at half the shape width at both ends) and, as the path progress goes 0→1, passes through six shapes in order (4-, 5-, 6-gon, star, 8-gon, circle) while rotating 0→450° (MorphSVG rotational, straight lines in between). Each time it passes a shape-change point (0 · .2 · .4 · .6 · .8 · 1), a 1px outline of that shape is left at the spot and fades with power2.out over .8s (+ remaining count × .15s). On touch devices, drag to move

options.sides: Shapes — number of sides separated by commas (0 is a circle, s is a star), default 4,5,6,s,8,0
options.trail: Length over which the trail fades (sec), default .8

use:
[ Let’s Talk ]
(Shape svg and dotted lines are created if missing)
note: Without MorphSVGPlugin the shape stays as is and only bumps and follows. The shape uses --kf-contrast-bg and the trace uses --kf-ink

from.where: index.html .nl-track (Contact). Original slater script: checkpoints 0·.2·.4·.6·.8·1, rotation 0→450, morphSVG rotational, x .1s none, phone drag, trail-clone power2.out.
